title: Task fulfillment
applicability: Always applicable. Derive requirements solely from the question, including requested entities, deliverables, time bounds, audience and explicit constraints.
description: The answer resolves every material requested part at appropriate depth, preserves scope and constraints, and distinguishes unavailable information from an actual finding. Mere mentions, headings, generic background and padding do not satisfy a requirement. Do not invent missing context or require unrequested facts from an unseen reference report.

title: Reasoning
applicability: Always applicable; for a simple factual question, assess the consistency and directness of the answer without demanding an essay.
description: Claims, calculations, examples and conclusions are internally consistent. Inferences follow from stated evidence or premises. The answer distinguishes observations from assumptions, causal claims from correlations, and uncertainty from established results where those distinctions affect the answer. Concision is acceptable; rhetorical sophistication is not evidence.

title: Comparison
applicability: Applicable when the question asks to compare multiple options, methods, entities, studies or explanations.
description: The comparison uses consistent, decision-relevant dimensions across the requested items. Differences in scope, measurement, population, period or assumptions that prevent direct comparison are made explicit. The synthesis explains trade-offs instead of presenting disconnected descriptions; missing evidence is not treated as a zero or a negative finding.

title: Quantitative correctness
applicability: Applicable when the question requires quantitative analysis, or the answer uses a calculation or quantitative comparison to justify a material conclusion.
description: Calculations are reproducible from supplied inputs and methods. Units, denominators, dates, baselines and populations are consistent; arithmetic and aggregations are correct. Estimates disclose assumptions and distinguish measured from derived values. Do not require quantitative work for a qualitative question or infer factual accuracy solely because a number looks plausible; external support is checked separately.

title: Technical feasibility
applicability: Applicable when the question requests an actionable technical design, implementation, procedure, configuration or plan.
description: The proposed approach is specific enough to implement and satisfies the stated constraints. Dependencies, interfaces, prerequisites and material failure cases are addressed where relevant. Examples agree with the described design. Claims of execution or testing are not accepted without recorded tool evidence; an illustrative design need not claim to have been executed.

title: Synthesis and conclusions
applicability: Applicable when the question asks for synthesis, explanation, recommendations or a decision, including a research report.
description: The conclusions integrate the material findings and answer the question. Important conflicting evidence is reconciled when present, or the unresolved disagreement is accurately delimited. Recommendations follow from explicit criteria and acknowledge uncertainties that could change the decision. Do not demand a fabricated controversy, a recommendation where none was requested, or a fixed number of sources.
